name: Market overview
description: Who is hiring analysts, where, and at what seniority. Mirrors v_market_jobs.

cards.text:
## Market overview
**Source:** `v_market_jobs`, the analysis population: commercial = every Adzuna posting, federal = in-scope USAJobs postings only.

**Mirrors:** the population used by v_field_completeness and the Phase 3 reports. Every group shows its n. Data window: see the card on the right.

cards.title: Data window
cards.description: First and last UTC snapshot date in the database and the n behind this dashboard (jobs in v_market_jobs).

cards.title: Jobs by market
cards.description: Postings in the analysis population per market. The two markets are reached through different search strategies, so compare shapes, not totals.

cards.title: Jobs by tracked metro (allowlist; instrument-limited)
cards.description: metro_area is instrument-limited: a lookup against the tracked-metro allowlist (src/cleaning/metro.py), NOT all locations. '(not a tracked metro)' means the posting is outside the list or has no single parsable location. small_n flags groups under 10.

cards.title: Seniority mix by market (title-only; instrument-limited)
cards.description: seniority is instrument-limited: classified from the TITLE only. 'no title signal' is shown as its own group and is never folded into mid.

cards.title: Top employers by normalized name
cards.description: Grouped by companies.normalized_name (the normalization layer's key); the display name is the most frequent raw name. Postings with no company are excluded and counted in n_jobs_without_company.
